assumptions: ['Sessions are the union of main-board bar dates inside the configured period.', 'Candidates are ranked only by score descending then thscode ascending and expire after one session.', 'Execution limits prefer reference_close and fall back to prev_close; raw close is only used for valuation.', "Each buy's total cost is capped by previous close equity times slot_fraction and by pre-open cash.", 'Buy cash is the cash present before same-open exits; same-open sale and dividend proceeds are excluded.', 'At non-final closes, exit priority is explicit exit_signals, stop_loss, profit_target, trailing_stop, then max_holding; existing pending exits are never overwritten.', 'Position value uses actual shares at the latest actual raw close plus gross receivables; buy_total_cost includes buy fees but not future sell fees or dividend tax.', 'Trailing stop uses the highest daily-close position value since entry, including the buy close; all holding exits are next-open signals and gaps can cross their thresholds.', 'Holding sessions include the buy session; max holding schedules an exit after that many closes.', 'A full exit is deferred if any shares are unavailable, including ex-date bonus shares.', 'Bonus shares become sellable on the next session; fractional bonus entitlements are floored to whole shares.', 'Rights are never exercised: no rights shares and no rights cash payment.', 'Dividend tax uses calendar holding boundaries of one month and one year.', 'Missing or invalid close values use the last actual raw price and are counted as stale valuations.', 'Cash-equivalent receivable equals held shares times previous_actual_close-reference_close; this is a scenario assumption, not a reconstruction of the actual corporate action.', 'Slippage cost is informational and already embedded in executed prices, not deducted twice.', 'Sharpe uses zero risk-free rate and sqrt(252); CAGR uses elapsed natural days and 365 days per year.', 'Top-N profit shares use positive net trade pnl divided by total positive net trade pnl.', 'A single configurable limit_rate is used without claiming historical ST status is known.']
